extracted.intended_audience: State educational agencies (SEAs), local educational agencies (LEAs), charter school operators, community-based organizations, grant applicants and administrators seeking ESSA funding
extracted.subtask_description: Index of allowable uses of funds and eligibility/operational requirements under ESSA programs (e.g., Title I, II, IV, charter grants, 21st CCLC, community schools). Lists program-specific permitted activities, service requirements, partnership expectations, and program-quality conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development to improve instruction and data use
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional development and other activities for teachers, paraprofessionals, and other school personnel to improve instruction and use of data from academic assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to strengthen instruction and use of assessment data; may be funded under targeted assistance and schoolwide programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address needs of children at risk via recruitment/retention
rubrics_metrics.description: Addressing the needs of all children in the school, but particularly the needs of those at risk of not meeting the challenging State academic standards, through activities which may include recruitment and retention of effective teachers, particularly in high-need subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may be used for recruitment and retention strategies targeted to students at risk of not meeting standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide enriched and accelerated curriculum to ensure well-rounded education
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing an enriched and accelerated curriculum, which may include programs, activities, and courses necessary to provide a well-rounded education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes academic enrichment programs and courses beyond standard offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services to children with greatest need for special assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing services to eligible children identified as having the greatest need for special assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted assistance funds should be directed to students with the highest levels of need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Last-resort health, nutrition, and social services
rubrics_metrics.description: If health, nutrition, and other social services are not otherwise available to eligible children in a targeted assistance school and such school has engaged in a comprehensive needs assessment and partnership with local providers, a portion of funds may be used as a last resort to provide such services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include provision of basic medical equipment (eyeglasses, hearing aids), compensation of a coordinator, family support and engagement services, integrated student supports, and necessary professional development. Funds may be used only if not reasonably available from other public/private sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dual or concurrent enrollment for targeted secondary students
rubrics_metrics.description: A secondary school operating a targeted assistance program may use funds to provide dual or concurrent enrollment program services to eligible children who are identified as having the greatest need for special assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports college-credit-bearing coursework for high-need students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schoolwide tiered model & early intervening services
rubrics_metrics.description: Using methods and instructional strategies to strengthen the academic program of the school, which may include a schoolwide tiered model to prevent and address behavior problems, and early intervening services, coordinated with similar activities under IDEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports schoolwide behavioral and early intervention frameworks aligned with special education coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanded learning time and out-of-school programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Using methods and instructional strategies to strengthen the academic program of the school, which may include expanded learning time, before- and afterschool programs, and summer programs and opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may support extended-day/year learning opportunities that advance student achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategies to increase parent involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing strategies to increase the involvement of parents of eligible children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include family engagement activities and parent outreach tied to student supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for personnel serving eligible children
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing professional development to teachers, principals, other school leaders, paraprofessionals, and, if appropriate, specialized instructional support personnel, and other school personnel who work with eligible children in targeted assistance programs or in the regular education program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Professional development may be funded in whole or in part by these programs; can be coordinated with other funding sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Before-school programs advancing academic achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: Before school programs and activities that advance student academic achievement and support student success (21st Century Community Learning Centers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities include LEAs, community-based organizations, tribes, other public/private entities, or consortia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career opportunities and advancement for educators
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing career opportunities and advancement initiatives that promote professional growth and emphasize multiple career paths, such as instructional coaching and mentoring (including hybrid roles that allow instructional coaching and mentoring while remaining in the classroom), school leadership, and involvement with school improvement and support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports initiatives to diversify and strengthen educator career ladders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated academic and career/technical education programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting programs that coordinate and integrate academic and career and technical education content through coordinated instructional strategies, which may incorporate experiential learning opportunities and promote skills attainment important to in-demand occupations; and work-based learning providing in-depth interaction with industry professionals and, if appropriate, academic credit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should align with state workforce needs and may lead to credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Perkins Act and WIOA
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that career readiness and workforce skills programs are aligned with the Carl D. Perkins Career and Technical Education Act of 2006 and the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alignment helps ensure quality and relevance to state/local workforce priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reform of principal/leader certification and preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming principal, or other school leader certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure that principals or other school leaders have the instructional leadership skills to help teachers teach and to help students meet challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include updating licensure standards, assessments, and approval processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reform of teacher certification to ensure subject-matter competence
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming teacher certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure that teachers have the necessary subject-matter knowledge and teaching skills, as demonstrated through measures determined by the State, which may include teacher performance assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State-determined measures may be used to verify teacher readiness in taught subjects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align teacher licensure with State academic standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming teacher certification/licensing requirements to ensure that teacher certification or licensing requirements are aligned with challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Licensure standards should support student achievement expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interstate teacher portability (voluntary consortium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling States, as a consortium, to voluntarily develop a process that allows teachers who are licensed or certified in a participating State to teach in other participating States without completing additional licensure or certification requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional interstate reciprocity to support teacher mobility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community engagement activities including recruitment costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Carrying out community engagement activities, which may include paying the cost of student and staff recruitment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may be used for outreach and recruitment tied to program participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand high-quality charter schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling eligible applicants to expand high-quality charter schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports expansion activities consistent with charter quality criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charter facilities financing (guarantees/insurance/reinsurance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guaranteeing, insuring, and reinsuring bonds, notes, evidences of debt, loans, and interests therein, the proceeds of which are used for acquisition, construction, renovation, or predevelopment costs necessary to commence or continue the operation of a charter school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to charter facilities financing needs for opening/operating schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitating financing and encouraging private lending for charters
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilitating financing by identifying potential lending sources, encouraging private lending, and other similar activities that directly promote lending to, or for the benefit of, charter schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical assistance to expand financing options for charters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate issuance of bonds for charter schools and provide technical assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilitating the issuance of bonds by charter schools, or by other public entities for the benefit of charter schools, by providing technical, administrative, and other appropriate assistance (including recruitment of bond counsel, underwriters, potential investors and consolidation of multiple charter school projects within a single bond issue).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports complex financial structuring for charter facility projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-pupil facilities aid program for charter schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing or enhancing, and administering, a per-pupil facilities aid program for charter schools; and carrying out evaluations, providing technical assistance, and disseminating information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State-level programs to support charter facilities on a per-pupil basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay costs to hire/compensate educators during charter planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing teachers, school leaders, and specialized instructional support personnel, including through paying the costs associated with hiring and compensating, during the eligible applicant’s planning period specified in the application, one or more of the following: teachers, school leaders, specialized instructional support personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports staffing costs during pre-opening planning phases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable opening and preparation for new charter schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling eligible applicants to open and prepare for the operation of new charter schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes startup activities necessary to commence operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay professional development costs for charter personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing teachers, school leaders, and specialized instructional support personnel, including through paying the costs associated with providing professional development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may cover training necessary for effective school start-up and operation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carry out renovations and minor facilities repairs (not construction)
rubrics_metrics.description: Carrying out necessary renovations to ensure that a new school building complies with applicable statutes and regulations, and minor facilities repairs (excluding construction).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited to non-construction renovation and repair to meet statutory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support replication of high-quality charter schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling eligible applicants to open and prepare for the operation of replicated high-quality charter schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports replication/expansion of proven charter models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquire supplies, training, equipment, and instructional materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquiring supplies, training, equipment (including technology), and educational materials (including developing and acquiring instructional materials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical allowable purchases to support instruction and operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide technical assistance to improve charter authorizing and oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance to eligible applicants and authorized public chartering agencies in carrying out the awarding of subgrants and enabling improved authorizing quality, including developing capacity for, and conducting, fiscal oversight and auditing of charter schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports capacity building for authorizers and oversight activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-time startup transportation costs for charter schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing one-time, startup costs associated with providing transportation to students to and from the charter school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited, non-recurring transportation startup expenses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-sustained opening/preparation costs for charter schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing for other appropriate, non-sustained costs related to opening and preparing for the operation of new charter schools, replicated high-quality charter schools, or expansion of high-quality charter schools when such costs cannot be met from other sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers exceptional startup costs not eligible from other sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Child sexual abuse awareness and prevention training for all personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing training for all school personnel, including teachers, principals, other school leaders, specialized instructional support personnel, and paraprofessionals, regarding how to prevent and recognize child sexual abuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training is explicitly allowable; repeated emphasis indicates priority for universal staff training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equitable services for eligible private school children
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing eligible children who are enrolled in private elementary and secondary schools special educational services, instructional services (including evaluations to determine the progress being made), counseling, mentoring, one-on-one tutoring, or other benefits that are equitable in comparison to services and other benefits for public school children participating in Title I programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include dual/concurrent enrollment, educational radio/TV, computer equipment and materials, other technology, and mobile educational services and equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish Congressional Academy for civics/history students
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishing a Congressional Academy that offers a seminar or institute for outstanding students of American history and civics, led by primary scholars and core teachers, conducted during summer or other appropriate time, duration not less than 2 weeks and not more than 6 weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies leadership, duration, and content focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce class size to evidence-based level via hiring
rubrics_metrics.description: Reducing class size to a level that is evidence-based, to the extent the State (in consultation with LEAs) determines such evidence is reasonably available, to improve student achievement through the recruiting and hiring of additional effective teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires evidence basis and state/LEA determination; focuses on hiring additional teachers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate and expand pipeline services for community schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating not less than 3 existing pipeline services (a continuum of coordinated supports from birth through postsecondary success) as of the date of the grant award, and providing not less than 2 additional pipeline services at 2 or more public elementary or secondary schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pipeline services must include at a minimum strategies such as community-based support, family and community engagement, high-quality early childhood education, high-quality school and out-of-school-time programs, juvenile crime prevention and rehabilitation, postsecondary/workforce readiness, and social/health/nutrition/mental health services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate pipeline services into comprehensive continuum to meet outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrating multiple pipeline services into a comprehensive, coordinated continuum to achieve annual measurable performance objectives and outcomes, including increasing the number and percentage of families and students targeted for services each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on measurable objectives and year-over-year growth in reach and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate community and government services with specialized personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating and integrating services provided by community-based organizations and government agencies with services provided by specialized instructional support personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages service alignment between external providers and in-school support staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous evaluation and program improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating continuously the success of the program and improving the program based on data and outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires ongoing monitoring and data-driven program adjustments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align program activities with State academic standards and partner externally
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that any eligible entity that receives an award from the State aligns the activities provided by the program with the challenging State academic standards, and that eligible entities identify and partner with external organizations, if available, in the community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where no experienced external organization exists, a nonprofit may enter into a written agreement to receive mentoring and guidance; programs should provide a list of prescreened external organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate federal/state funds to implement high-quality programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating funds received under this program with other Federal and State funds to implement high-quality programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages blended funding strategies to support comprehensive program design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct student services for postsecondary preparation and AP/IB exams
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities that assist students in successfully completing postsecondary level instruction and examinations accepted for credit at institutions of higher education (including AP and IB), which may include reimbursing low-income students to cover part or all of the costs of fees for such examinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports fee reimbursement for low-income students and access to college-level coursework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide access to academic courses not otherwise available
rubrics_metrics.description: Enrollment and participation in academic courses not otherwise available at a student’s school, including advanced courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May support distance or shared-course arrangements to expand curricular access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support CTE coursework aligned to State standards and credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Enrollment and participation in academic courses not otherwise available at a student’s school, including career and technical education coursework that is aligned with the challenging State academic standards; and leads to industry-recognized credentials that meet the quality criteria established by the State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes alignment to state standards and credential quality criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit recovery and academic acceleration to diploma
rubrics_metrics.description: Credit recovery and academic acceleration courses that lead to a regular high school diploma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports pathways for students to regain credits and accelerate toward graduation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outreach and communication to parents about direct student services
rubrics_metrics.description: Outreach and communication to parents about available direct student services in the LEA and State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parent outreach to increase awareness and participation in student supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation for school choice within accountability system
rubrics_metrics.description: Transportation to allow a student enrolled in a school identified for comprehensive support and improvement to transfer to another public school (which may include a charter school) that has not been so identified by the State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports student transfers as part of school improvement or accountability remedies.
